name: Sentinel Thenysil
summary: In Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil watches Ashenvale and the road south into Stonetalon. She tracks military movements and keeps scouts in neighboring lands, especially where allied forces move south.

sections.title: Watching the Borders
sections.body: At her post in Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil helps guard Ashenvale as hostility grows. Night elf lands across the region face steady encroachment, so the outposts must keep in touch. Much of the garrison defends the forest road. Thenysil sends Alliance volunteers beyond Ashenvale to aid distant allies.

sections.title: Ties to Stonetalon
sections.body: Sentinel Thenysil shares a close friendship and military bond with Kaela Shadowspear, an operative sent into the Stonetalon Mountains. When Thenysil learns Kaela was sent with an eccentric gnome mage, she takes the strange pairing as a sign of serious trouble in the peaks. Concerned for her comrade, she sends capable travelers south to support them and asks for a report on the mission.

sections.title: Audience in the Canopy
sections.body: Scouts return from Stonetalon with word that their strikes have driven back the Venture Company’s defiling operations. Sentinel Thenysil knows that stopping the company’s mechanized exploitation also protects the neighboring wilds. She commends the heroes, then sends them to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. There, High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind will receive them.

faq.q: Where can Sentinel Thenysil be found?
faq.answer: Sentinel Thenysil is stationed in Astranaar, the main night elf stronghold on Ashenvale’s central road.

faq.q: Why does Thenysil send travelers to Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Thenysil sends travelers south because her friend Kaela Shadowspear was sent to Stonetalon with a gnome mage. She takes the unusual pairing as a sign of danger and sends dependable travelers to support Kaela’s mission.
Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf scout and close friend of Sentinel Thenysil. She is stationed in Stonetalon, investigating threats to the land.

faq.q: What threats are being fought in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Venture Company has established invasive, destructive industrial operations in Stonetalon, strip-mining and clearing the forests.

faq.q: Why does Thenysil send adventurers to Tyrande Whisperwind?
faq.answer: After travelers help Kaela Shadowspear halt the Venture Company’s schemes, Thenysil sends them to Darnassus. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind will acknowledge their service to the night elves.

faq.q: What is Sentinel Thenysil's role in Astranaar?
faq.answer: From Astranaar, Thenysil watches regional intelligence and the borders. She sends reliable Alliance recruits to support distant garrisons.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see in Thenysil the Sentinels’ steady watch over Kalimdor’s sacred groves and their care for allied operatives across the borders.
As an Alliance adventurer, you may find in Thenysil a link between Ashenvale and Stonetalon, and a chance to earn favor with Darnassus’s leaders.
As a gnome, you may find Thenysil’s alarm at a gnome mage’s deployment to Stonetalon a reminder that your kind can still surprise the night elves.
